_source: Grouping written only from each system's own architecture document, frozen before any walk run (2026-10-31). TEAMMATES: the module table of 'TEAMMATES_5.110 Modular architecture - Final.docx' (UI, Logic and Storage layers; Common and Client subsystems; Test Driver). ArgoUML: the subsystem lists of the Cookbook at trunk@13713 (subsystems.xml: low-level, view and control, top level, loadable); modules the lists do not place hang from the root. A group's description is its document's name for it plus its members' blueprint descriptions, so the walk sees no knowledge the flat discover run did not.
